registryEntry.label: Enforce Least Functionality - Disable Cortana and MSIA
registryEntry.set_command: $created = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations' -Body (@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.windows10GeneralConfiguration';displayName='CMMC-LeastFunctionality';cortanaBlocked=$true;microsoftAccountSignInAssistantSettings='disabled'} | ConvertTo-Json) -ContentType 'application/json'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations/$($created.id)/assign" -Body (@{assignments=@(@{target=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.groupAssignmentTarget';groupId='{cuiGroupId}'}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; $created | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
